message: Throwing all decorum to the wind, Shio-chan threw her arms around me.

name: Shio
message: 「I... I finally did it! With these hands, with these arms, I defeated the mononoke!」
Saying that, I gently stroked Shio-chan's soft hair.

name: Shio
message: 「Ahh... nothing could ever make me happier than this... That I was able to do this is all thanks to--」

name: Shio
message: 「Yet, how strange it is... Even though I feel embarrassed, I do not wish to pull away...」
I felt the exact same way; my desire to stay wrapped in an embrace with Shio-chan like this won out.

name: Shio
message: 「While I was attacking... the sight of you holding back the mononoke's techniques with everything you had, Synn-dono... how gallant you looked.」

name: Shio
message: 「Being held tight against such a strong body... my heart will not stop pounding...\s03」
Shio-chan's face is so close. Our warm breaths faintly brush against each other.

name: Shio
message: 「C-Could it be... that right here and now is the exact moment to use the secret technique passed down directly from my elder sister!?」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me... you really aren't feeling well!? You might have a fever.」
Just like that, I press my forehead against hers to check her temperature. She's warm... and she smells so good.

name: Shio
message: 「L-Synn-dono... I, I-I am... at my limit.」

name: Shio
message: 「W-With the face of someone so dear this close to mine... I cannot hold myself back!」
Saying that, Shio-chan squeezed her eyelids shut and abruptly closed the distance between our faces.
